steps.content:
Syndicate
Margaret Street
Iron Gang Territory
The already narrow street is now crowded with weapon-wielding thugs, all eyeing today's target with undisguised greed and ferocity.
Gangsters from various gangs have all assembled with their weapons, ready to go full force against the besieged Iron Gang. Finally, the long-brewed fight breaks out.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: No good, boss, we're surrounded. All passages to Margaret Street are packed, and the underground exit has been barricaded.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Cub! Go seal off the back alley. No one is allowed through.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Everyone else, grab your toughest weapon and charge with me! Today we'll show them what you get when you come look for trouble on Iron Gang's turf!
Brenna leads her underlings forward. When the main target finally enters the scene, the mob immediately directs their firepower at the Iron Gang.

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: There's someone on the roof! Watch out for arrows! Send two guys after me upstairs to... Argh...

Attacks from the shadows prove far more efficient than direct confrontation. The Iron Gang has no choice but to switch to a defensive stance while their path gets hampered by stealthy attacks from the mob.
Gritting her teeth, Brenna manages to carve a bloody path through the brawl while protecting her people, yet she struggles to fend off the ambush.

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Die! Let today be your death anniversary! Hahahaha...
A sneak arrow flies toward the woman who's resisting fiercely while being pinned down and unable to fend it off.
Just before the arrow hits her, it gets blocked by a mechanical parasol emerging out of nowhere and ricochets onto an enemy nearby.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Mom!! Are you hurt?

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: I'm fine... Why are you here? I told you to leave!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I said I wouldn't run away this time. I never thought about abandoning everyone. I was just too naive before... But this time, I'd rather die fighting on this battlefield.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: ...And you're still naive now. Get over yourself. The Iron Gang can't possibly die out here.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I admit I'm naive. But dear boss Brenna, that naive girl has now saved you twice on two separate occasions!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: If you still won't let me fight as part of the Iron Gang, then I'll just fight on my own against our common enemies. That way, you can't stop me!
Golan opens her parasol, and with a sweep of the tough canopy sends two reckless thugs out of the way with their screams.
Brenna stares at Golan next to her and suddenly realizes she seems to have grown taller.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: ...Alright. If you've come prepared, show me what you've got.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Let's do this together!
As the enemies turn on each other to seize Golan, the girl fights alongside her mother, ripping open a gap in this scorched iron barrel of a battlefield.
Golan's appearance enlivens everyone's morale, reversing the course of the previously losing battle.
Three months of training and the determination to protect her gang allow Golan to exceed her potential in this battle, seizing the attackers' attention.

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Excellent! This is the weapon we need! She was completely clueless with her power before. I even planned to throw her into the underground arena for a couple of months to train her.

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Now, it seems she has indeed become the finest weapon. My brothers! Whoever captures her today will never have to worry about money or status anymore!

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Boss, no one dares to get close to her... We simply can't die our way through...

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Are you ******* kidding me?! Bring out our Mania weapons!

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: It's a bit of a waste to use my treasured possessions on this lousy gang. But in exchange for a living Sinner, it'll be more than worth it, hahahaha!
When the enemies bring out the Mania weapons, Brenna's pupils shrink, and her underlings are petrified as if they're looking at a monster. Everyone instinctively looks toward Golan.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Everyone!! Gather up!!
Golan tries to stay calm in the face of the Mania weapons, but her trembling hands betray her fear at that moment.

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Do you bastards have some kind of special gene that turns you into Sinners? Let's do an experiment. See how many precious Sinners I'll get after wiping out the Iron Gang with these weapons!
The hysterical, bloodthirsty mad dogs raise their old weapons coated with Mania Crystals. Contamination immediately oozes out of them.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Be careful, everyone! Panic will only benefit them. Stay calm and keep your guard up!

steps.speaker: Sunny
steps.content: Pro... Protect the boss! Let's fight them!

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: We can't let these scumbags hurt the boss and the boss lady!

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: ****, trying to run? You'll be the first then!
The Iron Gang underlings at the front simply cannot withstand the onslaught of the Mania weapons. Any resistance only leads to severe injuries under their power.
Once again shocked by the ruthless battlefield, Golan clenches her teeth to suppress her fear and charges with her parasol to the front to tackle the Mania weapon-wielding mad dogs.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Slow down! Get behind me! I'm a Sinner. Those things can't hurt me!
The taste of blood fills her mouth, but she still rushes over to put herself before Joy and Sunny, opening her parasol to block an attack.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Joy, take Sunny and run! She's too skittish for this. Take her somewhere safe! Now!
The remaining attackers block the way of all the Iron Gang members. She can withstand the Mania weapons, but she can't stop their detrimental impact on non-Sinners.
The Mania contamination makes the mad dogs even more frantic and the attackers even more reckless.
Golan tries her best to shield her comrades behind her, pointing the parasol at anyone trying to approach while struggling against the contamination of Mania radiation.

She seems unaccustomed to a battle of this scale. Having only had control over her Sinner abilities for a mere six months, Golan can do nothing but exhaust her power, unsure if she'll collapse the next second.

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: Boss lady... You must go now... Forget about us... This thing is too dangerous, you must take cover...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I won't leave you guys behind. Stay with me... Stay awake!

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: It seems... we really can't make it this time. You go first, we'll come right after you... Argh...

steps.speaker: Sunny
steps.content: Hurry up... Go, boss lady... It's too dangerous here...
The instant Golan is about to give in, the usually timid Sunny suddenly shoves her aside and headbutts the thug in front of her.

steps.speaker: Sunny
steps.content: Don't you dare... hurt... Golan!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Don't!
Not expecting someone to charge from under the Sinner's protection, the thug is caught off guard and stumbles back several steps. Sunny also faints from the strong impact.

When the thug recovers from the hit, he makes to pick up a brick and smash it on Sunny's head furiously. In that critical moment, Golan staggers over, grabs Sunny in her arms, and dodges the attack in a tumble.
The overwhelming impact blackens your vision, but you manage to save Golan and Sunny in your arms.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Cough... Cough cough... Chief... It's you?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Didn't I tell you not to come...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your mother told you the same thing, didn't she? If this is how a Sinner from the Bureau behaves, don't expect their Chief to be any better.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, I won't interfere with your decision. Consider me as... another party on the battlefield, handling things according to my own rules.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Come on, the Iron Gang's fight isn't over yet. Your important ones... still need your protection.
Golan gently settles the Iron Gang underling behind a barrier and immediately gets back up, gazing at the chaotic battlefield firmly.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I won't rely on others anymore... nor will I leave you guys behind... Not anymore... This time, I will hold on...
They have neither Mania weapons nor the same level of hysteria.
The Iron Gang is no match for those lunatics. The hysterical opponents no longer differentiate between friends or foes, beating any target they catch with a murderous intention.

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Kill... Kill them!! Kill them all! Mine!! Weapons!! All mine!!!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Watch out!!!
In a flash, Golan opens her arms and protects a comrade. With no time to pick up her parasol, she instinctively holds her comrade in her arms, exposing her own back.
With a dull noise, the enemy's club hits her on the back of the head.
Golan's head swims. Weakness and rage take over her mind with a buzz as uncontrollable tears from the pain overflow from her eyes.
Seeing Golan take the hit, the thugs let go of the targets in their hands and all begin to close in on her.
Golan staggers to her feet just to see her subordinates desperately holding back the thugs to get them away from her, but they are soon knocked down by the bloodthirsty opponents.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Bastard!

Golan roars, her rage piercing the sky. Her sanity seems to have left her as she picks up whatever is next to her, a brick, a stick, an iron pipe, a broken knife... and throws them at the thugs while backing off.
She retreats to the side of the Iron Gang members, not letting the attackers come any closer to her comrades.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You're looking for the Sinner, aren't you? Come on then! All of you! Let's find out which one is the most powerful weapon, me or that piece of junk in your hands!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I won't let them sacrifice themselves for me. I'll make sure they all survive. You're the ones who should die. I'll take them home... Yes, home... Just like before... when I wasn't a Sinner... I'll never let you hurt my family again...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I've said I won't run away ever again... I won't let you succeed. I won't let the Iron Gang disappear. I'll win this fight. I'll beat all of you pieces of shit, *******...
Golan fights tirelessly, until her hands are covered in blood, yet she feels no pain. She has forgotten pain.

Her mother has fallen. So has Joy and all the young and old underlings who call her boss lady. It's almost her turn now. But not yet. She keeps struggling to stay on her feet, until she can't anymore...
The setting sun disappears behind the horizon and the afterglow colors the whole sky.
At last... Golan can't hold on any longer.

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Yo-ho! Tie up all this garbage from the Iron Gang and take them away!

The attackers wave their flags as they plunder the spoils on the battlefield. Golan feels near-dead, but seeing them drag the barely alive members of the Iron Gang across the gravel path, she still tries with all her might to pick up the broken mechanical parasol and stagger over.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I've warned you! Don't...
Her labored effort is met with a crisp bullet. Blood immediately seeps out of her arm.
Whoosh!
The shackles emit a red glow. The mechanical parasol springs open with rage.
The already tattered canopy shoots a massive wave of energy at the enemies while the ribs expand into a transparent energy shield, guarding Golan and the Iron Gang behind it.
The attacking thugs are blown away by the sudden impact. Golan looks up and sees you standing beside her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's about time. Golan, you've done very well.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've held on for a very long time, pushing beyond your limit... You're incredible.
Having held back her tears until now, Golan freezes for a moment, then bursts out crying upon realizing that the explosion of power was due to your use of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Why? This isn't my power... This isn't my power!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Why... am I still so weak... In the end, I can only narrowly protect everyone relying on your power. It's true... I can't protect anyone at all...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I don't want to be... a damsel in distress who needs rescue all the time. I want to protect my important ones with my own hands. I don't want to rely on others!
Tears stream from Golan's red-rimmed eyes. She seems forever trapped in the walls that besiege her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's no shame in it. You did protect them with your own power.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Without your strong desire to protect your family, the shackles wouldn't have been able to summon the power within you. You own the power. The shackles are just a key to unlock it.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...If it weren't for your shackles, I couldn't have done it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No one is perfect or omnipotent in this world. You can't possibly solve every problem by yourself all the time, nor do you have to.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you're not yet strong enough, gather all possible power to guard those you wish to protect. You can face it alone when you finally find enough strength in yourself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Golan, do you wish to prove your strength, or to protect your family?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I want... to protect my family...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then the method isn't so important, is it? I believe those you wish to protect would want to stand against the hardship together with you. Your mom... and your friends in the gang... They must want that, don't they?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I guess so...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, Golan?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Yes?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is a formal question: Do you require my assistance in this battle?
Tears once again stream down as Golan nods.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Warning! The Minos Bureau of Crisis Control is investigating a Mania weapon riot in this area. As the Chief of the MBCC, I now instruct you to put down your weapons and cooperate with the investigation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sinner Golan, according to the MBCC Sinner Management Regulations, you have violated the rules regarding public behavior and will soon be detained.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: According to the DisCity Mania Weapon Control Act, individuals here involved in illegal possession and use of Mania weapons must also cooperate with the Bureau's interrogation.
Under the night sky, police lights surround the chaotic alley, casting bright colors onto the injured faces on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: I have no idea about this riot or the Mania weapons... Who saw them? Did you see them?

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Um... No...

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: Are these cops so bored they have to put on drama on the Iron Gang's turf at this hour... Do they want a proper fight with the Iron Gang or what?

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: I know... And isn't that girl from the Iron Gang the Sinner you're looking for? Take them all back. I bet they've got more of those hiding in the gang!

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: But that's the Iron Gang's heiress! If they let them whisk her away like that, it'll be a scandal for Iron Gang in the whole Syndicate!
Despite some of them constantly adding fuel to the fire, the gangsters here are all used to this kind of situation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: All related individuals, put down your weapons and cooperate with the investigation! As for Sinner Golan and those in possession of Mania weapons...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: It's me.
Clack!
The warm-toned headlights shine deep into the crowd. At the end of the light beam, Golan drops the weapon in her hand, stretching her hands toward you in a gesture of surrender.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sinner Golan has been captured. Next, the MBCC will conduct a rigorous search in this area for possession and use of Mania weapons. I encourage any individuals involved to turn yourselves in to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Enemy Boss
steps.content: Damn... Did she just... get caught by the cops? Since when do they intervene in gang business?

steps.speaker: Enemy Thug
steps.content: What's going on? Is she outta her mind? Those two...
The arrest team captures Golan easily. The gangsters whisper among themselves as they see her walk toward the police car without looking back.
Two underlings run over to grab her.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Boss lady, wait... I'll go get the boss, she'll save you...! Just wait!

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: Boss lady, don't go... You promised to let me follow you wherever you go...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You guys better stop picking fights every day, or sooner or later you'll end up a Sinner like me, and then you'll meet me in the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Sunny
steps.content: Boss lady... don't leave me behind...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I'll come back to visit you when I have time... Now get going, won't you?!
The three of them linger on the spot. Golan turns back to look at the injured crowd of the Iron Gang.
At the forefront of the crowd, Brenna's still standing there, a relieved smile crossing her blood-stained face.
This is the most reassuring outcome her mother hopes to see.
In that moment, Golan understands her mother's past and present intentions. She turns to sit in the car.

steps.speaker: Brenna
steps.content: Did you all see that? The Sinner you were fighting over is no longer with the Iron Gang. From now on, I won't show any mercy to anyone coming at us.
As the car leaves the scene, Golan looks through the window at her mother's back. She seems to be shielding her from the thousands of enemies, all by herself.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: It's different from what I imagined. I wasn't strong enough to protect my family on my own. But turns out, that's not too bad either. Maybe your method is indeed more effective...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Even though in the end, I'm still a powerless deserter, at least I protected my family in this way, and... I feel more at ease than before.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You fled from your family, from the MBCC, and now from that battle all for one purpose: To protect the Iron Gang and not let your Sinner identity affect them. Even if it means giving up your status in the Iron Gang and becoming a traitor and a deserter. But you did it. And in doing so, you've proven your strength.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Moreover, as the war escalates, it'll only involve even more greedy violence and affect more innocent people. I guess that's not what you want to see. It's better to admit your own weakness and escape once and for all. Just leave the problem to someone stronger, like the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Damn... I've never thought of that solution.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Uh... I mean, being Chief is really something else, huh? One moment you're strong, and the next you're weak. So what really am I?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Anyway... Thanks.

Two weeks after the heist
MBCC visitation room

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: I'll go first!

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: No, I'll go first.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: No, I'll go...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Alright! Just take turns and stop fighting!

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Big news, boss lady!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: What's wrong? Did those guys try to mess with us again?

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: No, they wouldn't dare anymore.

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: Right! Ever since you turned yourself in heroically that day, those losers started suspecting a trick. I mean, they can't believe a gangster would willingly go to the cops.

steps.speaker: Joy
steps.content: Then when they found out you could go on missions with the cops and come home from time to time, they became even more convinced... They now say you're playing both sides, dealing with the cops while bringing business to the Iron Gang... Who'd dare mess with someone like that?

steps.speaker: Cub
steps.content: As the story spreads... Nobody dares to come look for trouble anymore... Now those who knock on our door are looking to do business... We've in fact grown stronger than before!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Damn! I knew luck's always on the Iron Gang's side!
The visit ends, but Golan still has that silly happy look on her face. She doesn't even notice you walking past her.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Hehe, it's a bit bizarre, but I think I've gotten used to it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's bizarre?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: It's just, inexplicable things tend to happen in our family.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Such as?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: My ancestors were fishermen who sold fish for a living. But because the poker face ran in the family, someone got them into the debt-collecting business. That turned out well and business was good, so they gained some followers. Somehow, the group kept growing and eventually turned into a gang...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I thought that was the end of it... but then I got into the Bureau... and now they think I'm playing both sides and have protection from the cops? Wow, our family business is still going strong...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Tell Nightingale to arrange for more staff to monitor the Iron Gang's territory more closely.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just to make sure their family business doesn't go too strong.
